description: Partial Plugins module: one of two pinned operations; create_user remains source/input-gated under whm-api-client-8x0.1.22. Offline coverage only; live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.77 remains open.

evidence.note: Select only complete can_show_promotions as canShowPromotions with formally required plugin, strict native integer flag result, integer version 110, Plugins plugin and ordinary Flag outcome. Missing readonly/rollback keeps source risk UNKNOWN and existing default effective POST despite source GET. Preserve enabling-summary versus visibility-description contradiction and missing required plugin in CLI/URL samples; no enabling or read-only claim.

Formal plugin is required string despite CLI/URL samples omitting it. Only koality is documented; keep signature open and exact supplied bytes including empty without enum guards, default insertion or server acceptance claims; form POST follows existing unknown-risk default.

notes.text: Available from pinned integer version 110 and requires the Plugins plugin. Summary says Enable plugin promotions, while description determines visibility and parameter/result describe visibility without an enabled argument. Source omits readonly/rollback annotations: risk remains UNKNOWN and rollback is not established; effective default form POST differs from source GET. Do not infer read-only safety or a known enabling mutation.

plugin is formally required string; CLI/URL snippets omit it, an unresolved source discrepancy. Only koality is documented. Preserve requiredness and an open string signature without a client enum guard or a claim that alternatives are server-accepted. Empty, whitespace, Unicode, percent, ampersand and plus bytes encode once in the form body.

Optional can_show_promotions is strict native integer 0|1, rejecting quoted flags, booleans, floats and null. Payload 0 with UAPI status 1 is a normal result; status 0 still fails even with payload 1. Plugins is incomplete: create_user remains absent and uncounted under source/input gate whm-api-client-8x0.1.22; no new exclusion or waiver.

One invocation makes one immediate request on the selected account through direct or WHM-bridged UAPI, with ordinary Flag outcome. Selectors are lazy and cached without I/O or metadata reset. No implicit rendering, HTML/script evaluation, URL navigation/fetch/fallback, local file access, path normalization, extra request, cache of server data, retry or rollback.

Data is a required nonnull object with optional known fields; empty objects are valid, absent data or explicit null mismatches. Existing empty JSON array object compatibility and unknown-field filtering remain unchanged. UAPI status 0 and outer WHM failures still throw before payload validation. Inspect responseMeta() warnings and raw metadata, including after a mismatch.

Inputs are ordinary noncredential selectors; returned content, paths, URLs and metadata may be private. Existing SensitiveParameter protections cover library-owned response frames, not caller-readable payloads, mismatch payloads or third-party transport traces. Offline fixtures establish no server acceptance, live UI/session behavior or POST compatibility; live follow-up whm-api-client-8x0.2.77 remains open.
